_comment: Lore scrolls found at ancient sites (data/sites.json). Each scroll is found once per world and serves the whole group: its effects (same keys as research) add to every player's bonuses, and a scroll may unlock a rare tech (research.json, requiresScroll) for everyone in the group to research.

stribog_winds.name: Winds of Stribog
stribog_winds.description: Teaches the Wind Riders' craft (a rare tech).

svarog_rite.name: Rite of Svarog's Forge
svarog_rite.description: Teaches forging with Svarog's Ember (a rare tech).
